preconditions.description: The number of points to name is between 1 and 30, inclusive.
The x-coordinate of each point is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
The y-coordinate of each point is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
No two points have the same coordinates.

postconditions.description: The program must name all n points.

postconditions.expression: The points can be split by a line.
postconditions.description: There exists a line that separates the points with black and white hats such that all points of one color lie on one side of the line and all points of the other color lie on the other side.

postconditions.expression: No points lie on the line.
postconditions.description: No point lies on the line that separates the points with black and white hats.
The program reports the coordinates of two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) that form a line separating the points with black and white hats.
